description: Add goals — **several in one call**. A goal has a name; a target amount and a target date are optional, and an open-ended goal is a real answer. Its kind is optional and drives nothing (EARMARKED when left out, as the goal form makes it); how many months of expenses the bank should hold is the cushion (`set_cushion`). **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak before anything is written. **The goal form’s one question is `default_holding`**: a bank account’s Cash, a place kept by hand or a new one takes `already_there`; a holding a broker’s rows buy is followed by its rows, with nothing to type; a bank account’s Cash can count the transfers into it (`from_transfers`). Editing, closing and deleting a goal are app-only, except its default holding (`set_goal_deposit_categories`).

commit.description: Default false. False previews the batch; true writes it.

goals.description: One entry per goal. Up to 60 in a call.

already_there.description: How much of the money is already there, in major units — the goal form’s "How much of it is already there?". Written as a Was already there deposit into `default_holding`. Not for a holding bought by rows: a goal on one follows its rows, and those are its deposits.

already_there_on.description: The day `already_there` stands for, as YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

default_holding.description: What the money is held in. `{ "id": … }` for a holding `savings` listed, or `{ "name": …, "kind": …, "is_liquid": …, "provenance": …, "place": … }` to create one. **Money always lands in a holding**, never in a bare place: the cash and the fixed deposit at one bank are two holdings, and only one of them is reachable this week.

is_liquid.description: Whether the money is reachable this week. **The user’s answer, not the kind’s** — a fixed deposit with six months to run is not liquid. Needed only when creating.

kind.description: One of CASH, DEPOSIT, FUND, TRACK, SECURITY, OTHER. Needed only when creating.

name.description: The holding by name. A name matching nothing creates it.

place.description: Where the money is — the bank or broker. `{ "id": … }` for a place `savings` listed, or `{ "name": …, "kind": … }` to create one. Needed only when creating the holding.

kind.description: One of CHECKING, DEPOSIT, INVESTMENT, CASH, OTHER. Needed only when creating.

name.description: The place by name. A name matching nothing creates it.

provenance.description: One of RECORDED, TRANSCRIBED, VALUED: how the balance is known. RECORDED is the running total of what was entered and nothing will ever confirm it; TRANSCRIBED means a statement prints the figure; VALUED means holdings times a price. **Declared, never inferred** — a deposit with no statement transcribed yet is still TRANSCRIBED. Needed only when creating.

from_transfers.description: The goal form’s "Transfers into <account> are for this goal": with a bank or cash account’s Cash as `default_holding`, every confirmed transfer arriving there after `already_there` is a deposit, one leaving it a withdrawal. Off unless the user says the account is for this goal.

kind.description: Optional, and drives nothing: one of EMERGENCY, SHORT_TERM, LONG_TERM, RETIREMENT, EARMARKED.

note.description: Anything worth keeping about the goal.

priority.description: Lower is funded first by the splitter. Defaults to last, because a goal added today has not earned a place above the rent.

target_amount.description: What they are aiming for, in major units. Leave out for an open-ended goal.

target_date.description: When they want it by, as YYYY-MM-DD.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
